facility.name: Masterbuilt Kids Early Childhood Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 304 FRAZIER ST, NAVASOTA, TX, 77868

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Machine Wash Linens: A 4-month old infant was placed in the crib with soiled sheets. This was corrected at inspection when the sheets were changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Machine Wash Linens (26 TAC §746.3407(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: There were 2 infants in the bucket seat during meal time without the safety straps fastened. This was corrected at inspection when the safety straps were fastened and secured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: A 4-month old infant was observed being placed on the infants stomach in the crib for naptime. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver took the infant out of the crib to console back to sleep in the rocking chair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: An annual fire inspection has not been conducted for year 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on the evidence obtained, there is sufficient evidence of parents not signing incident reports.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: The nursery classroom was over ratio by 2 infants. This was corrected at inspection once the infants were moved to another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: 2 infants were observed sitting in the bucket seats without safety straps fastened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: There were 4 caregivers lacking between 2 to 16 hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Based on the evidence obtained, there is sufficient evidence of caregivers on their personal cell phones and not attending to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Fed in Safe Manner: An infant was observed with a bottle inside of the crib while sleeping. This was corrected at inspection when the bottle was removed from the crib.     An infant was observed walking around with a bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Fed in Safe Manner (26 TAC §746.2419(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An infant was observed sleeping with a bib on in the crib. This was corrected at inspection when the bib was removed from the infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: One classroom had a hole in the wall where the doorknob can fit through.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Allows Children To Fall Inside Structure Onto Other Parts: The toddler playground and pre-k playground contained jungle gym play equipment utilized by the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Allows Children To Fall Inside Structure Onto Other Parts (26 TAC §746.4603(2))

occurrences.finding: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level-Written Approval: Children were being cared for in a room that is not approved by the local authority or licensed by Childcare Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level-Written Approval (26 TAC §746.4217(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was observed a caregiver talking on the cell phone in the classroom while children were in care.    It was observed that a caregiver walked out of the classroom leaving children unattended.     It was observed that a caregiver was not actively supervising children during naptime, the caregiver's back was towards the children while sitting in a chair for more than 2 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: It was observed that a bottle was in a crib while a child was sleeping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection, there was a caregiver caring for children in the younger toddler classroom with a pending background check. This was corrected at inspection once the caregiver left the operation.     An administrative penalty will be recommended as a result of this citation, per HRC ?42.078.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: Operation staff with conditions on the background check was left alone to provide care for children.       An administrative penalty will be recommended as a result of this citation, per HRC ?42.078.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level-Written Approval: Children were being cared for in a room that is not approved by the local authority or licensed by Childcare Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level-Written Approval (26 TAC §746.4217(1))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 6 children files were audited during the inspection.  4 of the 6 files did not have a current immunization record or affidavit available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During the inspection a caregiver did not know the number of children responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: 6 children files were audited.  6 files did not have emergency care authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: One caregiver was overheard telling a child in care "Get over there!  Sit down!"
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: 6 children records were audited.  2 of the 6 did not have a health statement available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: During the unannounced inspection there was no documentation for safety and emergency drills available.                                This was fixed when drills were documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: During an unannounced inspection it was found fire drills had not been conducted since the opening of the operation.                             This was fixed when a fire drill was conducted during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Telephone with Listed Number: During the investigation it was found the operation does not have a main phone line for parents to contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Telephone with Listed Number (26 TAC §746.4507(1))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Supervised By Qualified Caregiver: During the investigation it was found children were in the care of an unqualified caregiver without direct supervision of a qualified caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Supervised By Qualified Caregiver (26 TAC §746.1109(b)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During the investigation a caregiver was observed aggressively grabbing a child by the arm and popping another child on the hand twice with force on the surveillance cameras.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: During an investigation it was found the permit holder is not familiar with the minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During the course of a DFPS investigation it was found a caregiver responsible for a group of children in care was using their cell phone to take selfies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on preponderance of the evidence there is sufficient evidence that children in care were neglected.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Two staff files reviewed were found to have completed CPR training online without the use of a manikin.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A television was found to be playing a children's show in a classroom with a child that was under the age of two years old. This was corrected at inspection when the television was turned off and the children engaged in other activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: During the inspection it was found bottles were being rinsed out in the diaper changing hand washing sink.     This was corrected at inspection when a new procedure to send bottles home to be washed was implemented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the inspection a caregiver was observed stepping outside of the classroom leaving the group of 9 children ages 1 1/2 to 6 unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: During the inspection four children's files were reviewed, 1 child's file was not available for review, 3 children's files were found to not have health statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection: While reviewing documents there was no sanitation inspection available for viewing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3403)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers: While reviewing the first aid kit there were no tweezers available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: While doing a walkthrough there were holes in the ground in the outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: While reviewing 5 staff files there were no notarized affidavits available for viewing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Duration: While reviewing the operational policy it was found there was no duration of indoor and outdoor play available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Duration (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(B))
